name: Unwip 0.43.42
body:
Polish and speed:
- The Record button no longer has a red dot while it isn't recording: it shows an empty ring, so it can't be mistaken for recording. While Replay or a screen video is on, it's solid red with a pulsing dot, as before.
- Phone and iPad: Dropbox sync sends and fetches several files at once instead of one by one, so a big book syncs roughly two to three times faster.
